title: In-app camera capture and camera settings for inspection photos

requirements.summary: Add an in-app camera capture modal to the New Vehicle Inspection photo uploader and attach captures to the existing photos state.
acceptanceCriteria: In the "New Vehicle Inspection" form, the Photos section includes a "Use Camera" action alongside the existing file upload input.
Tapping "Use Camera" opens a modal/dialog that shows a live camera preview (after permission is granted).
The modal includes a "Capture" button that takes a still image and adds it to the existing photos grid preview in the form.
Captured images are added to the same `photos: ExternalBlob[]` state used by the current upload flow, and can be removed with the existing remove UI.
If camera permission is denied/unavailable, show an English error message and provide a fallback path to upload files instead.
Stopping/closing the camera modal releases the camera stream (no camera indicator remains active after closing).

file_operations.description: Create a capture modal component that shows a live camera preview and provides Capture/Close controls, using the selected "camera" component hook `useCamera` for start/stop/capture and preview refs (verify the component's usage instructions before implementing). Ensure the dialog stops/releases the stream on close and on unmount, and displays English permission/support error messaging with a clear fallback to file upload.

Add a "Use Camera" action next to the existing photo file input, open/close the new CameraCaptureDialog, and append captured images into the existing `photos: ExternalBlob[]` state (same as uploads). Keep existing remove UI working for both uploaded and captured photos. Use the existing `ExternalBlob` type (from the selected "blob-storage" component) for photo state compatibility (verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

requirements.summary: Add camera settings (camera selection and quality) inside the capture modal and persist preferences in localStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: The capture modal provides a "Camera" setting to switch between available video input devices when more than one camera is available (e.g., front/back cameras).
If enumerating devices is not available until permission is granted, the UI still supports switching via a "Front/Back" toggle using `facingMode` as a fallback.
The capture modal provides a "Photo quality" or "Resolution" setting with at least 2 options (e.g., Standard / High) that affect capture constraints.
Selected camera device (or facing mode) and quality setting are saved in browser localStorage and restored on next open.
All user-facing labels/help/errors for camera settings are in English.

file_operations.description: Add a small localStorage-backed helper for camera preferences (preferred facing mode / optional device label+id when available, and a quality preset such as Standard/High), including safe read/write with defaults and English-only error/label constants where needed.

Add a settings section within the capture dialog: (1) a "Camera" selector that uses `navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices()` when available after permission to determine whether multiple cameras exist, and supports switching via the selected "camera" component's `switchCamera` / `facingMode` fallback; (2) a "Photo quality" (or "Resolution") selector with at least two presets that change the `useCamera` config constraints (width/height/quality). Persist and restore these settings using the localStorage helper (verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

requirements.summary: Convert camera captures into ExternalBlob bytes and ensure they render and submit identically to uploaded photos.
acceptanceCriteria: A captured image is converted into bytes and wrapped as `ExternalBlob` (same type as file uploads) before being added to form state.
Captured images render correctly using `photo.getDirectURL()` in both the inspection form preview grid and the inspection details dialog photos grid after submission.
Submitting an inspection with camera-captured photos works end-to-end without backend changes.

file_operations.description: On Capture, take the `File` returned by the selected "camera" hook, convert it to bytes (ArrayBuffer -> Uint8Array), wrap it as `ExternalBlob.fromBytes(...)` (selected "blob-storage" component; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing), and return it to the parent so it is appended to the existing inspection form `photos` state.

Ensure captured `ExternalBlob` objects are appended to the same `photos` array as uploads so the existing preview rendering via `photo.getDirectURL()` and submit payload remain unchanged, enabling end-to-end submission without backend changes.
